abilities.name: Spawn Egg
abilities.description: Place an Egg at target location, revealing the nearby area. Upon dying, Murky respawns at the Egg after 8 seconds. Murky only grants 25% of a real Hero's experience upon dying. If Murky's Egg is killed, he is revealed to enemies for 15 seconds, and Spawn Egg is placed on cooldown. Egg's Health regenerates by 42 per second, scaling by 4% per level, after a 5s delay. Murky gains a 35% of maximum Health Shield for 10 seconds upon reviving from an Egg. Respawn Egg ; 15; trait

fields.notes: Minions, Mercenaries and Monsters do not attack the Egg. Enemy Structures can attack the Egg, dealing normal damage to it. Egg remains killed until Murky places a new one. Every time Murky respawns in the Hall of Storms (due to dying without an active Egg) a new Egg is automatically spawned in the Hall of Storms as well.

abilities.name: Slime
abilities.description: Deal 86 damage and apply Slime on nearby enemies for 6 seconds, Slowing them by 20%. Deal 210 damage to enemies who are already Slimed. Structures take 50% damage.

fields.notes: Subsequent applications refresh Slimed duration. All Murkys on a team benefit from the "Slimed" debuff on enemies, regardless of who placed it on the target.

abilities.name: Pufferfish
abilities.description: Spit out a Pufferfish with 225 Health at the target point. After 2.75 seconds, the fish will blow up for 310 damage. Deals 50% less damage to Structures. Quest Kill Slimed enemies, or hit them with Pufferfish. Minions give 1 stack. Heroes and Structures give 5 stacks. At 200 stacks, Basic Abilities now deal full damage to Structures. Reward At 400 stacks, Murky gains 50% Health and increases in size. Pufferfish Explode

fields.notes: The three-second detonation timer starts after Pufferfish has landed. Self-casting Pufferfish causes the projectile phase to be omitted, leaving the Pufferfish at Murky's current location and instantly initiating the detonation timer. Enemies can kill the Pufferfish to prevent it from exploding. Pufferfish cannot be hit by skillshots. The Pufferfish can be targeted and attacked by enemy Structures. Minions, Mercenaries and Monsters do not attack Pufferfish. Damage reduction to Structures stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Pufferfish 's damage.

abilities.name: Safety Bubble
abilities.description: Becomes Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While active, Murky cannot attack or use Abilities.

fields.notes: Safety Bubble cannot be manually canceled.

abilities.name: March of the Murlocs
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 130 damage and Slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.; 100; heroic

fields.props: Channeled cast (stationary), Damage over Time, Skillshot, Slow
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its cast puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Summons a total of 36 Invulnerable Murlocs over 6.75 seconds. Murlocs spawn in one of 10 possible locations every 0.1875 seconds. Each Murloc sticking to a target applies new instances of DoT and Slow that tick separately. New applications do not refresh the duration of pre-existing Slow and DoTs. Slow stacks additively up to 5 times with itself, but not with other sources of Slows. Minimum Movement Speed for affected targets is 0.4843, even in combination with self-Slows. Damage reduction to Structures stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect March of the Murlocs 's damage.

abilities.name: Octo-Grab
abilities.description: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.; 50; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.notes: The cast is interrupted if the target moves more than 2 units past its maximum cast range, going on a 10 second cooldown.

talents.name: Toxic Buildup
talents.description: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack against an enemy Hero causes a free Slime to be cast upon them.

fields.notes: Toxic Buildup 's Slime has the same properties as baseline Slime and interacts with all talents affecting Slime. Attacks while Murky is Blinded or the target is Evading will progress through the 3-step cycle as if they had hit, except that the free Slime will not trigger (progress toward this Talent wasted). Stacks toward the free Slime are tracked separately for every enemy Hero and all stacks on a particular Hero expire after 10 seconds without Murky Basic Attacking them.
